messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Medication and treatment and Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions in Rhineland-Palatinate during the 2000s and 2010s, matching this research need: Data on adult vaccination coverage, preventive health checkups and cancer screening, smoking, alcohol, diet, physical activity, blood pressure knowledge, health risk perceptions, and demographic characteristics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
